Package com.hiface.sdk.common

Class HiFaceResult<T>

java.lang.Object
com.hiface.sdk.common.HiFaceResult<T>
public final class HiFaceResult<T> extends java.lang.Object
Cross-platform SDK operation result.

Success has a non-null value; failure has a non-null error. Factory methods keep these two states mutually exclusive.
